jobs.occupation: Inetum - Business Consultant Manufacturing & Supply Chain
jobs.description:
Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Inetum Consulting is a strategy and transformation consulting firm part of the Inetum group. With a team of 450 multidisciplinary consultants, we are present in Europe (France, Spain, Portugal, Belgium) and Africa (Morocco).

Inetum Consulting supports companies and public organizations in their strategic projects through five major offerings: CIO Advisory, Sustainability, Data & GenAI, Transformation & Change, Corporate Functions Advisory.

Guided by a sector-specific consulting approach enriched by innovation and technological solutions, we help our customers steer their transformation towards sustainable performance and a more resilient, responsible society.

We value a unique and strong corporate culture, imbued with the values of excellence, which contributes significantly to the success of organizations.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Senior Azure / .NET Architect
jobs.description:
We're reimagining a mission-critical communication platform that powers how systems exchange data, files, and events with the outside world. This is not a greenfield toy project-it's a high-impact transformation at scale.

As a Senior Azure .NET Architect, you'll help design and shape a next-generation, cloud-native integration platform. You'll take an existing, complex ecosystem and turn it into a resilient, high-performance, event-driven architecture running on Azure.

If you enjoy solving hard distributed systems problems and building platforms that truly matter-this role is for you.
💡 What you'll be doing

You won't just "contribute"-you'll shape the future architecture:

• Design and build a modern communication layer handling message and file ingestion, transformation, routing, and delivery (sync + async)

• Create resilient, fault-tolerant systems using proven patterns like retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and event-driven workflows

• Architect scalable event-driven solutions using Azure messaging services and/or Kafka-style pub/sub systems

• Build high-quality .NET services (.NET 7/8, C#, ASP.NET Core, gRPC/REST) with a strong engineering culture (TDD, clean code, performance-first)

• Deploy and operate workloads on Kubernetes (AKS/OpenShift) using Helm and modern CI/CD pipelines

• Define observability from day one: logging, tracing, metrics, SLOs, and actionable runbooks

• Collaborate in a truly agile setup, working closely with engineers, product owners, and other teams

• Mentor and elevate others-your experience will help raise the bar across the team

🎯 Why this role stands out

• High impact: You're building a core platform that everything depends on

• Real engineering challenges: Distributed systems, scalability, resilience-no trivial work here

• Modern tech stack: Cloud-native, Kubernetes, event-driven, .NET latest

• Ownership & influence: Your architectural decisions will shape the platform long-term

• Collaborative culture: Work with experienced engineers who care about doing things right

• Extensive experience in software engineering (15+ years), including building distributed, high-throughput, or mission-critical systems

• Strong hands-on Azure expertise (AKS, Functions, messaging services, Storage, monitoring, CI/CD)

• Deep knowledge of .NET (C#, modern .NET, async programming, testing practices)

• Solid understanding of event-driven architecture and distributed system trade-offs

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production environments

• A mindset focused on quality, automation, and continuous improvement

• Confidence to make architectural decisions and guide others

• Strong communication skills in English

 

🌟 bonus points:

• Experience with observability stacks (Opentelemetry, tracing, logging platforms)

• Exposure to large-scale messaging or file transfer systems

• Knowledge of secure integration protocols (e.g., sFTP, AS2/AS4, messaging queues)

• Experience working in regulated or high-reliability environments

jobs.description:

Contract: Freelance, 1 to 2 years

Start: As soon as possible

Languages: Native Dutch or French, plus good English
The opportunity

Our client, a Belgian federal public administration, is running a major digital transformation programme to modernise its business applications, strengthen collaboration between teams and build a more integrated, agile IT landscape. The programme is organised into domains, each led by a Domain Delivery Lead who brings several agile squads together around one vision.

We are recruiting three Domain Delivery Leads, each owning one domain of the programme

• Platform & Integration: the cross-domain technical backbone: integration, releases, Azure cloud, DevOps, security and data migration.

• Public Sector Transformation: a high-profile, politically sensitive public service domain.

• Digital Public Services: a domain delivering strategic applications behind core public services.

All three are senior delivery and programme management roles. You lead through influence, clarity of vision and trust rather than control. You will not be writing code or building infrastructure; you make it possible for several agile teams to deliver.
What you will do

• Unite several agile squads around a shared vision and keep business and team priorities aligned

• Create the conditions for autonomy and coach teams towards maturity (servant leadership)

• Build the overall plan with the teams, manage cross-team dependencies and arbitrate priorities transparently

You will join the Customer Service department of a Belgian molecular diagnostics company based in Mechelen. Our client develops innovative diagnostic solutions that help healthcare professionals make faster, better-informed decisions for patients. Your work contributes directly to that mission.

Customer Service is a collaborative team. You work every day with colleagues from sales, logistics and other departments, in an international environment where customers and colleagues speak many languages. Short lines of communication, a fast pace and a shared focus on customer satisfaction define how the team works.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a natural communicator who enjoys solving problems and making customers feel heard? Do you speak fluent English and Spanish? Then this Customer Service Representative role in the life sciences sector may be your next step.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the first point of contact for customers and the link between them and the teams working behind the scenes. You listen, work out what is needed, and make sure it gets sorted quickly and properly.

What you will do

• Handle customer questions by phone and in writing: orders, billing, cancellations, account queries, complaints and errors
• Welcome customers warmly, understand their issue and either resolve it yourself or route it to the right colleague
• Take in and process orders, and arrange refunds and exchanges where needed
• Create and maintain customer accounts with accurate, up-to-date information
• Support shipping and transport documentation and answer related questions
• Log and follow up on service requests
• Help coordinate product recalls when they occur
• Spot customer needs and share ideas for relevant products or services with management
• Work closely with the commercial team, logistics, Finance, Quality, Regulatory and Legal

As a Customer Service Representative you should have the following characteristics:

• A bachelor’s degree in languages or economics, or equivalent knowledge gained through experience or training
• At least 3 years of experience in a comparable customer service or order management role within an international sales organisation. Experience in medical devices or life sciences is a clear advantage
• Fluent English and Spanish, spoken and written. Dutch or other European languages are a plus
• Solid knowledge of the order process, and hands-on experience with an ERP system (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics AX)
• Good command of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
• Strong telephone skills and a real talent for listening
• An analytical and organised way of working, with careful documentation
• The ability to juggle several tasks, stay calm in a fast-changing environment and handle conflicts constructively
• Good interpersonal skills and the confidence to make an impact
Nice to haves

• Experience with Salesforce CRM
• Knowledge of how to use artificial intelligence in your daily work
